label: cbepctl
type: a per-node, per-bucket diagnostic tool that changes live ep-engine (KV storage engine) runtime parameters - checkpoint configuration, flusher/pager thresholds - without persisting the change over a cluster restart. Distinct from cbstats (read-only) and from couchbase-cli setting-* commands (persisted, cluster-wide).
evidence: This tool is a per-node, per-bucket operation. That means that the IP address of a node in the cluster and a named bucket must be specified.
Changes to the cluster configuration using cbepctl are not persisted over a cluster restart.
This command changes checkpoint configuration parameters.
note: CONCURRENT-MINT COLLISION, caught and folded per the reconcile skill's own worked example: two of this round's parallel extraction batches independently minted tool:cbepctl from two different files (cbepctl-intro.json and cbepctl/set-checkpoint_param.json), plus a third file (cbstats-intro.json) and a fourth (cbepctl/set-flush_param.json) also reference it - one promoted record now reflects all four, not two separate silent duplicates.
relates_to_competency_question: Which tool lets an administrator change ep-engine runtime parameters live, without persisting the change?
